name: Ryuuzouji Takamasa
source:
Personally scouted into Tenjin Academy by [url=/c9948]Nabeshima[/url] himself, Takamasa has the potential to earn himself that recommendation. He has some martial skill being able to hold his own against normal opponents, qualifying him to be one of the "10 Warriors of the West." Being the son of a very famous host, he has also inherited the ability to charm women. It's insinuated he has held many women. He also has social skills that allow him to be a talk show host.

[From [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Ryuuzouji_Takamasa]Majikoi Wiki[/url]]
